text: Bots run on a persistent cloud computer with a browser, filesystem, and terminal, and keep working while your laptop is closed
quote: Your Bots run on a persistent cloud computer with a browser, filesystem, and terminal... and work continues while your laptop is closed.

text: Set up a Bot by describing the job in a message instead of using a workflow builder, granting access as it asks
quote: Setup is a message, not a workflow builder. Create a Bot, describe the job, and grant access as it asks.

text: Multiple Bots can run in parallel, message each other, share context, and hand off task ownership
quote: Your Bots can run in parallel, message each other, share context in group chats, and pass ownership of a task, so you aren't the router between tools.

text: Walk a Bot through a multi-step process once and it saves it as a reusable skill it can rerun on a schedule
quote: Walk a Bot through a multi-step path once, and it can save the path as a skill and rerun it on a schedule.

text: Named Bots keep their memory, files, browser sessions, and preferences across sessions
quote: A named Bot keeps its memory, files, browser sessions, and preferences across sessions instead of resetting on every task.

text: Linux desktop app available as .deb, .rpm, and AppImage packages
quote: a `.deb` package for Debian and Ubuntu, an `.rpm` package for Fedora and RHEL, or an AppImage for other distributions.

text: Access can be linked to an existing SuperGrok subscription
quote: If your access comes from a SuperGrok subscription, link it when the app asks.

text: Bots can investigate performance regressions by reviewing dashboards, traces, and flamegraphs to identify hotspots
quote: Investigate the checkout latency increase since yesterday's release. Review dashboards, traces, and flamegraphs; identify the highest-confidence hotspot

text: Action approval prompts let you allow once, always allow by saving a rule, or deny
quote: **Allow once** lets the Bot continue with that action, **Always allow** can save a matching rule, and **Deny** blocks it.

text: Auto Review evaluates tool calls and computer actions against configurable rules before they run
quote: With Auto Review on, Grok Bot evaluates tool calls and computer actions before they run. Open Settings → General → Auto-review to add rules.

text: The Bot hands control back to you for passwords, passkeys, 2FA codes, CAPTCHAs, and payment confirmations
quote: For passwords, passkeys, two-factor codes, CAPTCHAs, and payment confirmations, the Bot should hand you control of the computer.

text: Admins can control which network destinations team computers can reach
quote: It controls which destinations team computers can reach.

text: Bots can use browser-based tools, including services that have no dedicated connector
quote: Grok Bot can use many browser-based tools, including services without a dedicated connector.

text: Grok Bot has its own usage allowance, separate from Grok and Cursor plans
quote: Grok Bot comes with its own usage, separate from your Grok and Cursor plans, so anything you hand off to a Bot won't count against your existing usage.

text: Message a Bot from phone or desktop and continue the same thread on either device
quote: You can message a Bot from your phone or desktop, the way you would text someone on your team, and pick up the same thread later on either surface.

text: An engineering Bot can reproduce a UI bug, file a ticket, and hand the fix to a debugging Bot
quote: an engineering Bot reproducing a bug in the product UI, filing the ticket, and handing the fix off to a debugging Bot.

text: Bots can build a website, purchase a domain, deploy it, configure plugins, and set redirect rules
quote: Builds the site, purchases the domain, and deploys the final version. Helps configure plugins, delivers a live URL, and adds redirect rules.

text: Bots can produce custom creative assets through an art pipeline based on your creative direction
quote: Visits the art pipeline and makes the custom assets according to your creative direction.

text: Team Bots have their own handles and can be invited to shared channels where everyone can interact with them
quote: Each Team Bot has its own handle, so you can invite it to a channel where everyone can ask questions, contribute context, and see its responses.

text: iPhone and Android apps let you start work, answer questions, approve steps, and review results
quote: Use Grok Bot on iPhone or Android to start work, answer questions, approve steps, and review results away from your desk.

text: On iPhone, the system share sheet can send photos, files, links, or text into a Bot chat
quote: On iPhone, use the system share sheet and choose Grok Bot to send a photo, file, link, or text into a chat.

text: Duplicate a Bot to reuse the same role for a different scope
quote: Duplicate a Bot when you want the same role as a starting point for a different scope—for example, one Account Health Bot per region.

text: Share a Bot template so others can start from the same Bot
quote: Share a template when someone else should start from the same Bot.

text: Team Bots can handle shared jobs such as answering metrics questions from a data warehouse or keeping docs current as PRs ship
quote: Team Bots suit one shared job, such as answering metrics questions from your data warehouse, keeping docs current as PRs ship

text: Live voice chat with a Bot
quote: Choose Start voice chat when the composer is empty to talk with the Bot live.

text: Bots show editable email and message drafts that you review, then send or discard
quote: the conversation can show an editable draft. Review the recipients and body, then choose Send email or Send message, or Discard.

text: Group chats can include two to six Bots at once
quote: In New chat, select two to six Bots.

text: Supports CSV, JSON, YAML, source-code files, and Jupyter notebooks
quote: CSV, JSON, YAML, and source-code files ... Jupyter notebooks

text: Agent Computer live preview shows the Bot's desktop clicks, typing, navigation, and status
quote: Open Agent Computer from a conversation to view the shared desktop. The preview shows clicks, typing, navigation, and current status.

text: Connectors are installed as plugins from a Marketplace
quote: Connectors are installed as plugins from Marketplace.

text: Schedule skills to run on a recurring basis, such as every weekday at 8:00 AM
quote: Every weekday at 8:00 AM, run the Daily customer-risk skill against the current account list.

text: Routines can be triggered by events such as Slack messages or GitHub notifications
quote: Cursor account integrations can start a routine from an event, such as a Slack message or a GitHub notification.

text: Bots can run commands on your local desktop, with per-command approval by default
quote: Execution on Local Computer controls whether Bots can run commands on the desktop in front of you; per-command approval is the default

text: The Bot's cloud computer web traffic can be routed through your current desktop
quote: Turn on Route egress through this desktop to send your Grok Bot computer's web traffic through the current desktop.
